title: How Her Birthday Celebration Turned into a Disaster
description:
► One of Everything Bundle [Limited time]
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On June 22, 2024, a woman set out to celebrate her birthday in La Crosse, WI. But the festivities took a turn when a disturbance call was made to dispatch. Staff reported that the woman was highly intoxicated and refused to leave the premises. When informed of her impending arrest, she made her presence well known to the officers.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
